title: Learned Gallery
subtitle: A 244-weight network that lays photos out on your sketch and lines them up with a penalty, not a snap.

chapters.title: Photos from a sketch
chapters.blurb: Twenty slot positions pass through 244 weights to become rectangles, and Adam steps move them onto a sketch.

chapters.title: Lining up without snapping
chapters.blurb: A misalignment penalty and slowly growing multipliers pull nearly aligned photo edges onto one line.

chapters.title: Taking steps back
chapters.blurb: Each frame of training is kept or undone, and the loop learns when to stop.

chapters.title: What held, what didn't
chapters.blurb: Four penalty forms, the measured alignment, the edges that still rest off target, and a status with no held-out test.
